spans.s:
खेटित, अस्, आ, अम्, terrified, scared, startled,
frightened.
खेटित खेटित. See under rt. खिट्.

खेट् खेट्, cl. 10. P. खेटयति, -यितुम्, to
eat, consume.

खेट खेट, अस्, m. a village, the residence
of peasants and farmers; a small town, half a Pura;
phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor of the
body; a horse; the club of Bala-rāma; (अम्), n.
grass; (अस्, अम्), m. n. hunting, the chase [cf.
आ-खेट]; a shield; (अस्, आ, अम्), having a weapon or
weapons, armed; vile, bad, low; (at the end of com-
pounds expressing defectiveness or deterioration, e. g.
नगर-खेटम्, a miserable town.)
—खेट-पिण्ड,
अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a ball of phlegm, i. e. any-
thing impossible.

खेटक, अस्, m. a village, the residence of agri-
cultural peasants, a small village; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a
shield; the club of Bala-rāma (?).
—खेटक-पुर,
अम्, n., N. of a town.

खेटिन्, ई, m. a lecher, a libertine; [cf. नागर
fr. नगर.]
खेटिक खेटिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

खेटिताल खेटिताल, अस्, m. a minstrel, a
family bard or piper, whose business is to awaken the
master of the house with music and singing; [cf.
वैतालिक.]
